title: INTRODUCTION TO INSTRUMENTATION AND MEASUREMENT SYSTEMS
description: Illustrates the function, operation, and application of common mechanical engineering instruments, measurement principles, and statistical analysis. Demonstrates elements of measurement systems, including transduction, signal conditioning, and data recording. Examines function and operation of digital data acquisition systems.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ME 217 and (ENGR 202 or 202H) and (ENGR 213 or 213H).
A minimum grade of C is required in ME 217, ENGR 202, ENGR 202H, ENGR 213 and ENGR 213H.
